description: Policy for the initial gzip JavaScript and CSS of each public Next.js route, checked by tests/next-bundle-budgets.test.mjs. Limit = baseline + max(ratio x baseline, minBytes) + approvals. Baselines live one file per route in config/next-bundle-budgets/baselines/ and are rewritten only by `npm run budget:next:baseline` from a main CI measurement; growth above the tolerance needs a new file in config/next-bundle-budgets/approvals/. See docs/runbooks/next-bundle-budgets.md.
